title.narrative: Individual Heat Substations and Energy Efficiency Improvements - Mykolaiv - NEFCO (Nordic Environment Finance Corporation)

description.narrative: The overall objective of the project is to receive a feasibility study that can outline how to improve the energy efficiency and optimize the district heating system of Mykolaiv city, thus strengthening the city’s ability to respond to impacts generated by the war situation. The feasibility study will include how to do this by looking into aspects aspects, such as optimizing heat consumption by the residential sector as well as gas consumption of the city and and improving heat distribution in the city via construction of new municipally owned district heating network in Mykolaiv. Moreover, the study will look at ensuring a decent level and sustainability of district heating services for the population and internally displaced persons residing in the city.
